description: Get details for one active job on Kollegia by its id (from search_jobs): the ad text (shortened, without contact details), requirements, salary, deadline, location, employer and the kollegia.no url where the user applies. Returns an error if the job is no longer active.

id.description: Job id from search_jobs (the last part of https://kollegia.no/jobs/{id}).

name: get_job

deadline.description: Last day the ad is open (YYYY-MM-DD).

description.description: The ad text, shortened, contact details removed.

employer_url.description: Employer page or career page on kollegia.no.

occupation_url.description: Occupation page with salary statistics on kollegia.no.

monthly_nok.description: Monthly salary in NOK (median of SSB, or the stated amount converted).

text.description: Salary as shown on kollegia.no, e.g. '250–280 kr/t' or 'ca. 245 kr/t'.

url.description: The job on kollegia.no. Give this to the user; they apply there.

title: Én stilling
